caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical pottery vessel with a slightly flared rim. The main color of the vessel is a warm, earthy orange-brown, characteristic of terracotta or fired clay. Two broad, horizontal black bands encircle the vessel: one near the top just below the rim and another toward the bottom. Between these bands, several thinner, parallel black lines are evenly spaced, running horizontally around the middle portion of the vessel. At the top, just below the rim and above the first black band, there is an inscription that reads "ZOOAGRO" in black uppercase letters. The background is plain and light beige, making the vessel the central focus of the image. Below the vessel, in the blank area, the sequence of numbers and letters "180306" is written in grayish-blue.
title: Zoar Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
